name: domain
description:
SISTRIX domain analytics. Pick `view`:
- 'visindex': Visibility Index (organic Google visibility score). Modifiers: history, daily, date, limit.
- 'visindex_overview': current value + country/SERP breakdown. Modifier: daily.
- 'kwcount': total number of organic keywords the domain ranks for. Modifiers: history, date, limit.
- 'kwcount_top10': number of keywords ranking in the organic top 10. Modifiers: history, date, limit, extended.
- 'urlcount': number of the domain's URLs ranking in the organic top 10 and top 100. Modifiers: history, date, limit.
- 'competitors': closest organic-search competitor domains (returns domain names). Modifier: limit.
- 'ideas': relevant keyword ideas for the domain (returns keyword strings). Modifiers: limit, page, regex_keyword.
- 'opportunities': keywords with high ranking-improvement potential. Modifiers: limit, offset.
- 'ranking_distribution': how ranking keywords spread across SERP pages. Modifiers: history, percent, date.
- 'traffic_estimation': estimated organic traffic by top keywords. Modifiers: limit, offset.
- 'hosts': top-ranking hostnames (subdomains) of the domain. Modifiers: limit, offset.
- 'paths': top-ranking directories of the domain or host. Modifiers: limit, offset.
View-specific params are ignored for views that do not use them.

domain.description: Domain to analyze, without protocol or path, e.g. 'example.com'.

view.description: Which data view to return; the tool description explains each value and its modifiers.

history.description: If true, return the historic time series instead of only the latest value.

daily.description: If true, use daily instead of weekly Visibility Index data points.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format to query a specific point in time; omit for the latest data.

percent.description: If true, return the ranking distribution as percentages instead of absolute counts.

extended.description: If true, include extended keyword-count data (view='kwcount_top10').

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

offset.description: Number of result rows to skip (offset-based pagination).

regex_keyword.description: RE2 regex to filter keyword ideas, e.g. 'shoes?.*'.

name: keyword
description:
SISTRIX keyword analytics (keyword-centric). Pass the search term as `keyword` (alias: `kw`). Pick `view`:
- 'seo': top organic ranking positions for the keyword (returns domain/position/url). Modifiers: limit, domain, url, history, date.
- 'metrics': key data points (competition, CPC, traffic, clicks, device split).
- 'traffic': search volume + clicks. Modifiers: show_all (full history), show_all_countries.
- 'competition': how contested the keyword is in organic search.
- 'searchintent': search-intent classification with shares.
- 'serpfeatures': SERP features present. Modifiers: show_all_types, date.
- 'traffic_estimation': estimated organic clicks per SERP position. Modifier: limit.
- 'questions': Google queries phrased as questions containing the keyword. Modifiers: lang, limit, page.
View-specific params are ignored for views that do not use them.

view.description: Which data view to return; the tool description explains each value and its modifiers.

keyword.description: Search term to analyze, e.g. 'running shoes'. Provide this or `kw`.

kw.description: Alias for `keyword` (SISTRIX API naming). Provide one of the two.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

domain.description: Only return rankings of this domain, e.g. 'example.com' (view='seo').

url.description: Only return rankings of this exact URL (view='seo').

history.description: If true, return the historic time series instead of only the latest value.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format to query a specific point in time; omit for the latest data.

show_all.description: If true, return the full search-volume history (view='traffic').

show_all_countries.description: If true, include search volume for all countries (view='traffic').

show_all_types.description: If true, list all SERP feature types, not only those present (view='serpfeatures').

lang.description: ISO 639 language code for the questions, e.g. 'de' (view='questions').

name: keyword_domain_seo
description: All organic Google keywords the given domain ranks for, each with its position and ranking URL. Filter by position range (`from_pos`/`to_pos`), `serp_feature`, `ai_answer`, or regex on keyword/url/host; paginate with `limit`/`offset`. Domain-centric counterpart of the keyword tool (which is keyword-centric).

domain.description: Domain to analyze, without protocol or path, e.g. 'example.com'.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

offset.description: Number of result rows to skip (offset-based pagination).

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format to query a specific point in time; omit for the latest data.

search.description: Substring filter on the keyword text, e.g. 'shoes'.

from_pos.description: Only keywords ranking at this position or worse (lower bound, e.g. 1).

to_pos.description: Only keywords ranking at this position or better (upper bound, e.g. 10).

ai_answer.description: If true, only keywords whose SERP shows an AI answer (e.g. Google AI Overview).

serp_feature.description: Only keywords whose SERP contains this feature, e.g. 'video', 'featured_snippet'.

regex_keyword.description: RE2 regex filter on the keyword text.

regex_url.description: RE2 regex filter on the ranking URL.

regex_host.description: RE2 regex filter on the ranking hostname.

name: links
description:
SISTRIX backlink analytics for a domain. Pick `view`:
- 'list': individual backlinks (up to 10,000), each with link_from, link_to, and anchor text. Modifiers: offset, regex_link_from, regex_link_to, regex_link_text.
- 'linktexts': most common anchor texts by frequency (returns strings).
- 'linktargets': the domain's most-linked-to URLs with backlink/linking-domain counts.
All views accept `limit`. The offset/regex_* filters only apply to view='list'.

domain.description: Domain to analyze, without protocol or path, e.g. 'example.com'.

view.description: Which data view to return; the tool description explains each value and its modifiers.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

offset.description: Number of result rows to skip (offset-based pagination).

regex_link_from.description: RE2 regex filter on the linking page URL (view='list').

regex_link_to.description: RE2 regex filter on the link target URL (view='list').

regex_link_text.description: RE2 regex filter on the anchor text (view='list').

name: project
description:
SISTRIX Optimizer project analytics (excluding onpage-crawl data — use project_onpage for those). Pick `view`:
- 'overview': list all Optimizer projects with their hash IDs. Needs no `project`; call this first to obtain the hash for the other views.
- 'competitors': competitor domains configured for the project. Modifiers: limit, page.
- 'ranking': registered rankings with positions/traffic. Modifiers: limit, offset, tag, date, regex_keyword.
- 'visibilityindex': Visibility Index timeline for the project's domain. Modifiers: competitors (bool, include competitor curves), tag, date.
- 'keyword_serps': SERPs for a keyword within the project. Requires `keyword` (alias: `kw`). Modifiers: searchengine, country, city, device, date.
- 'external_links': outgoing external links of the project. Modifiers: limit, page.
Every view except 'overview' requires the `project` hash.

view.description: Which data view to return; the tool description explains each value and its modifiers.

project.description: Optimizer project hash ID; get it from view='overview'. Required for every other view.

keyword.description: Search term for view='keyword_serps'. Provide this or `kw`.

kw.description: Alias for `keyword` (SISTRIX API naming). Provide one of the two.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

offset.description: Number of result rows to skip (offset-based pagination).

tag.description: Only include keywords carrying this project tag.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format to query a specific point in time; omit for the latest data.

regex_keyword.description: RE2 regex filter on the keyword text (view='ranking').

competitors.description: If true, include competitor domains' visibility curves (view='visibilityindex').

name: project_onpage
description:
SISTRIX Optimizer onpage-crawl data. Requires the `project` hash (from project view='overview'). Pick `view`:
- 'meta': project name and tags.
- 'overview': high-level error/warning totals from the latest crawl.
- 'crawl': per-category breakdown of errors/warnings. Modifier: date.
- 'issue': rows behind a single issue type. Requires `issue` (one of 105 keys; common: title_tag_missing, title_tag_empty, same_title, long_title, missing_meta_snippet, empty_meta_snippet, same_meta_snippet, missing_h1, empty_h1, same_h1, duplicate_content, thin_content, broken_external_link, broken_external_links_3xx, page_not_found, noindex, robots_block_crawling, alt_attribute_missing). Modifiers: limit, offset, date.
- 'links': internal/outbound links found during the crawl. Modifiers: limit, page.
- 'urls': all crawled URLs. Modifiers: limit, offset.
- 'resources': loaded resources (CSS/JS/images/...). Modifiers: limit, page.
- 'resources_usage': per-resource usage counts. Modifiers: limit, page.
- 'cookies': cookies set during the crawl. Modifiers: limit, page.
Invalid issue keys are rejected at runtime with the full list of valid options.

project.description: Optimizer project hash ID; get it from the project tool, view='overview'.

view.description: Which data view to return; the tool description explains each value and its modifiers.

issue.description: Issue key, required for view='issue'; e.g. 'title_tag_missing'. Invalid keys are rejected with the full list of valid options.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

offset.description: Number of result rows to skip (offset-based pagination).

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format to query a specific point in time; omit for the latest data.

name: ai_check
description: SISTRIX AI Check: visibility of brands and domains across AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode). Pass any number of `brands` and/or `domains` (single string or list, up to 100 each; at least one of the two is required). Pick `view`: 'overview' (analyzed scope, prompt count, per-model + per-country breakdown), 'competitors' (competing brands), 'prompts' (most relevant prompts incl. model and answer), 'prompts_count' (historical prompt counts per day, `limit` = history days), 'sources' (cited sources, use `source_type`=host/domain/url). Covers ai.check.overview, .competitors, .prompts, .prompts.count, .sources. Note: view-specific optional params (model, source_type, limit, page) are silently ignored when the chosen view does not accept them.

view.description: Which data view to return; the tool description explains each value and its modifiers.

brands.description: Brand name(s) to check, string or list of up to 100, e.g. 'Adidas'. At least one of brands/domains is required.

domains.description: Domain(s) to check, string or list of up to 100, e.g. 'adidas.com'. At least one of brands/domains is required.

model.description: Filter by AI model: 'aimode' (Google AI Mode), 'aio' (Google AI Overviews), 'chatgpt'; omit or 'all' for all.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

name: ai_topicresearch
description: SISTRIX AI Topic Research: which topics people discuss with AI chatbots around a keyword. Pick `view`: 'overview' (aggregate for a `keyword`: number of topics, avg. dialog length, journey-stage and intent distribution), 'list' (the individual topics for a `keyword` incl. topic_label, search volume, dialog length, journey stage, intent; filter via `intent`/`journey_stage`/`country`, paginate via `limit`/`page` — costs 1 credit per returned topic), 'topic' (full detail for one `topic` = a topic_label from 'list': buyer persona, emotional driver, next best action, unasked questions, leading brands, per-model prompt library). Covers ai.topicresearch.overview, .list, .topic. Typical flow: overview → list → topic.

view.description: Which data view to return; the tool description explains each value and its modifiers.

keyword.description: Keyword to research topics for, e.g. 'holidays'. Required for view='overview'/'list'. Provide this or `kw`.

kw.description: Alias for `keyword` (SISTRIX API naming). Provide one of the two.

topic.description: Topic identifier: the `topic_label` returned by view='list'. Required for view='topic'.

intent.description: Filter by intent group ('learning', 'commercial', 'transactional', 'informational') or a fine-grained intent value (view='list').

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. 'DE' (view='list'). Omit for all countries.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

name: ai_tracker_overview
description: SISTRIX AI: list AI tracker projects available to this API key, with their hash IDs (use those in ai_tracker). Covers ai.tracker.overview.

name: ai_tracker
description: SISTRIX AI: per-project tracker views. Pass the project hash from ai_tracker_overview. Pick `view`: 'environment' (entities seen by the tracker), 'prompts' (tracked prompts with brand visibility), 'competitors' (competing brands, supports `model`), or one of 'sources_domains'/'sources_urls'/'sources_hosts' (source rankings at different granularities, support `model`). Covers ai.tracker.environment, .prompts, .competitors, .sources.domains, .sources.urls, .sources.hosts.

project.description: AI tracker project hash ID; get it from ai_tracker_overview.

view.description: Which data view to return; the tool description explains each value and its modifiers.

model.description: Filter by AI model: 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'aio' (Google AI Overviews), 'aimode' (Google AI Mode); omit or 'all' for all (competitors/sources views).

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

name: ai_prompt_answers
description: SISTRIX AI: fetch the answers generated by AI models for a given prompt. Optionally filter by `model` (aimode/aio/chatgpt) or `country`. Covers ai.prompt.answers.

prompt.description: The prompt text to fetch AI-generated answers for, e.g. 'best running shoes'.

model.description: Filter by AI model: 'aimode' (Google AI Mode), 'aio' (Google AI Overviews), 'chatgpt'; omit or 'all' for all.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.
